rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thanks for thinking of Halcyon Threshold — and congrats on landing an interesting beat. I'm not able to go on record by tomorrow's deadline, and would rather wait until I can speak to this properly than give you something rushed. Happy to stay in touch for future pieces once I have more to show. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: **Declined** Tessa Brandt's (Larkin Dispatch) request for a named quote.

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Corvid Institute <ops@corvidinstitute.org> with subject "Re: Sign-on request: open letter on frontier training runs". It read: "Hi, Thanks for including Halcyon Threshold — I think this kind of coordination matters. I'm not able to sign on as a named, published signatory on this particular letter right now. Appreciate the work you're doing on this, and please feel free to loop us in on future efforts. Best, Morgan Hale"
rows.quote: **Declined** the Corvid Institute's open letter sign-on (would've published your name/affiliation).

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Really glad the talk landed — and thank you for the offer, this is exactly the kind of help that's hard to come by. Here's something concrete: I'd like a clear-eyed map of the landscape before committing to anything, so we're actually filling a gap rather than adding another reading group or newsletter to the pile. Would you be up for pulling together a short landscape doc over the next couple of weeks? Roughly: 1. A list of active funders/programs relevant to independent AI safety work (e.g. Emberfall Fund, Compute Commons, Alignment Commons) — size of grants, cadence, what they're actually looking for. 2. A list of who's already doing evals work, grant-making, reading groups, etc. in this space, so we can see what's genuinely neglected vs. crowded. 3. Your honest read on where a part-time, two-person-ish effort with a small budget (low thousands of dollars) could plausibly add value in the next 3-6 months. No need to be exhaustive — a page or two of real signal beats a long list. Take whatever slice of the 5 hours/week makes sense, and send me what you have whenever it's ready; no fixed deadline yet. Thanks again for this, Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya Raman (volunteer) with a concrete first task: map the funding/opportunity landscape and who's already working on what
